text:
Maya: Late-shift heads-up — noticed a small perf regression on canary after the microkernel patch (commit 9b3f2a). p95 token latency for short sequences jumped. Anyone else seeing this?

Devon: saw it too. Canary traffic at 03:14 showed p95 ~62ms vs baseline ~38ms for seq<=64. Noticed higher context-switches in the logs.

Liam: +1. Reproduced locally with the minimal repro. Looks related to the new slot allocator path.

Aisha: Ran a focused bench (seq=8/32/64) — pasted raw outputs:
```
# run: ./bench --model distil --seq 64 --warm 100 --iter 500
seq=8  p50: 12.1ms  p95: 18.3ms
seq=32 p50: 22.8ms  p95: 39.6ms
seq=64 p50: 28.9ms  p95: 61.8ms  <-- regression vs baseline ~38ms
```
Also attached flame trace showing extra `slot_refill()` time. Link: https://bench.redwood/trace/1739999001

benchbot: Automated canary summary: 2026-03-18T03:12Z — baseline: p95=38.4ms, canary: p95=62.1ms, delta=+61.6% (alert threshold breached).

Sam: Thanks — can we triage without full revert? Quick asks: 1) bisect the commit for the slot change, 2) run a hotfix profile build with the allocator toggled off, 3) short canary rollback plan if hotfix fails.

Maya: Plan: Devon to bisect, Aisha to run allocator-off hot build and bench, Liam to prep revert CL if needed. I'll notify infra for a quick canary rollback window at 03:45 UTC.

Devon: Starting bisect now. First suspicion is the `slot_sync()` tweak in 9b3f2a. Will report delta after two checkpoints.

Aisha: Spinning a hotbuild with `--slot-allocator=legacy` now, expect results in ~12m. Pinging @Liam for quick CR review of the revert CL if I hit the same numbers. :pray:

Liam: Will standby and review CL ASAP. If we need rollback, prefer safe revert of 9b3f2a and follow with smaller patch.

Maya: Also quick FYI for observability — add a custom gauge for slot refill latency so we can detect early next time. Filing tiny ticket after this thread.

Sam: Noted. Anything blocking mid-shift handoff?

Devon: No blockers other than the bisect. I'll post updates at the two checkpoints (after each bisect step).

Aisha: Bench results posted in ~10m.

Maya: Great — thanks everyone. If you get +regression repro, please attach the `bench --log=full` output here.

Devon: update 03:28 — bisect step 1 ruled out unrelated allocator refactor, narrowed to 9b3f2a or its immediate parent.

benchbot: Note: Canary traffic continuing; p95 drift still present but fluctuating 58–64ms.

Aisha: 03:35 — hotbuild with `legacy` allocator: seq=64 p95=39.2ms. Looks like toggling allocator fixes it. Uploading diffs and raw logs.

Maya: OK, sounds actionable. Liam, Sam — proceed with staged revert and brief canary rollback at 03:45 if CI passes. I'll update ops channel. :thumbsup:

Liam: preparing revert CL now. Will add test to prevent regression in the microbench harness.

Sam: I'll coordinate the rollback window and watch metrics.

Maya: Thanks all — I’ll close the loop after rollback or if the revert is unnecessary.
